description: Manages DNS records using the v2 REST API of the DNS Made Easy service. It handles records only; there is no manipulation of domains or monitor/account support yet. See: https://www.dnsmadeeasy.com/integration/restapi/.

parameters.name: account_key
parameters.description: Account API Key.

parameters.name: account_secret
parameters.description: Account Secret Key.

parameters.name: autoFailover
parameters.description: If true, fallback to the primary IP address is manual after a failover. If false, fallback to the primary IP address is automatic after a failover. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: contactList
parameters.description: Name or ID of the contact list that the monitor notifies. The default '' means the Account Owner.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain to work with. Can be the domain name (for example mydomain.com) or the numeric ID of the domain in DNS Made Easy (for example 839989) for faster resolution.

parameters.name: failover
parameters.description: If true, add or change the failover. This is applicable only for A records. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: httpFile
parameters.description: The file at the Fqdn that the monitor queries for HTTP or HTTPS.

parameters.name: httpFqdn
parameters.description: The fully qualified domain name used by the monitor.

parameters.name: httpQueryString
parameters.description: The string in the httpFile that the monitor queries for HTTP or HTTPS.

parameters.name: ip1
parameters.description: Primary IP address for the failover. Required if adding or changing the monitor or failover.

parameters.name: ip2
parameters.description: Secondary IP address for the failover. Required if adding or changing the failover.

parameters.name: ip3
parameters.description: Tertiary IP address for the failover.

parameters.name: ip4
parameters.description: Quaternary IP address for the failover.

parameters.name: ip5
parameters.description: Quinary IP address for the failover.

parameters.name: maxEmails
parameters.description: Number of emails sent to the contact list by the monitor. Default: 1

parameters.name: monitor
parameters.description: If true, add or change the monitor. This is applicable only for A records. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: Port used by the monitor. Default: 80

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: Protocol used by the monitor. Choices: "TCP" "UDP" "HTTP" ← (default) "DNS" "SMTP" "HTTPS"

parameters.name: record_name
parameters.description: Record name to get/create/delete/update. If record_name is not specified; all records for the domain are returned in “result” regardless of the state argument.

parameters.name: record_ttl
parameters.description: Record’s “Time-To-Live”. Number of seconds the record remains cached in DNS servers. Default: 1800

parameters.name: record_type
parameters.description: Record type. Choices: "A" "AAAA" "CNAME" "ANAME" "HTTPRED" "MX" "NS" "PTR" "SRV" "TXT"

parameters.name: record_value
parameters.description: Record value. HTTPRED: <redirection URL>, MX: <priority> <target name>, NS: <name server>, PTR: <target name>, SRV: <priority> <weight> <port> <target name>, TXT: <text value>”. If record_value is not specified; no changes are made and the record is returned in result (in other words, this module can be used to fetch a record’s current ID, type, and TTL).

parameters.name: sandbox
parameters.description: Decides if the sandbox API should be used. Otherwise (default) the production API of DNS Made Easy is used. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: sensitivity
parameters.description: Number of checks the monitor performs before a failover occurs where Low = 8, Medium = 5,and High = 3. Choices: "Low" "Medium" ← (default) "High"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the record should exist or not. Choices: "present" "absent"

parameters.name: systemDescription
parameters.description: Description used by the monitor. Default: ""

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If false, SSL certificates are not validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Fetch my.com domain records
  community.general.dnsmadeeasy:
    account_key: key
    account_secret: secret
    domain: my.com
    state: present
  register: response

- name: Create a record
  community.general.dnsmadeeasy:
    account_key: key
    account_secret: secret
    domain: my.com
    state: present
    record_name: test
    record_type: A
    record_value: 127.0.0.1

- name: Update the previously created record
  community.general.dnsmadeeasy:
    account_key: key
    account_secret: secret
    domain: my.com
    state: present
    record_name: test
    record_value: 192.0.2.23

- name: Fetch a specific record
  community.general.dnsmadeeasy:
    account_key: key
    account_secret: secret
    domain: my.com
    state: present
    record_name: test
  register: response

- name: Delete a record
  community.general.dnsmadeeasy:
    account_key: key
    account_secret: secret
    domain: my.com
    record_type: A
    state: absent
    record_name: test

- name: Add a failover
  community.general.dnsmadeeasy:
    account_key: key
    account_secret: secret
    domain: my.com
    state: present
    record_name: test
    record_type: A
    record_value: 127.0.0.1
    failover: true
    ip1: 127.0.0.2
    ip2: 127.0.0.3

- name: Add a failover
  community.general.dnsmadeeasy:
    account_key: key
    account_secret: secret
    domain: my.com
    state: present
    record_name: test
    record_type: A
    record_value: 127.0.0.1
    failover: true
    ip1: 127.0.0.2
    ip2: 127.0.0.3
    ip3: 127.0.0.4
    ip4: 127.0.0.5
    ip5: 127.0.0.6

- name: Add a monitor
  community.general.dnsmadeeasy:
    account_key: key
    account_secret: secret
    domain: my.com
    state: present
    record_name: test
    record_type: A
    record_value: 127.0.0.1
    monitor: true
    ip1: 127.0.0.2
    protocol: HTTP # default
    port: 80 # default
    maxEmails: 1
    systemDescription: Monitor Test A record
    contactList: my contact list

- name: Add a monitor with http options
  community.general.dnsmadeeasy:
    account_key: key
    account_secret: secret
    domain: my.com
    state: present
    record_name: test
    record_type: A
    record_value: 127.0.0.1
    monitor: true
    ip1: 127.0.0.2
    protocol: HTTP # default
    port: 80 # default
    maxEmails: 1
    systemDescription: Monitor Test A record
    contactList: 1174 # contact list id
    httpFqdn: http://my.com
    httpFile: example
    httpQueryString: some string

- name: Add a monitor and a failover
  community.general.dnsmadeeasy:
    account_key: key
    account_secret: secret
    domain: my.com
    state: present
    record_name: test
    record_type: A
    record_value: 127.0.0.1
    failover: true
    ip1: 127.0.0.2
    ip2: 127.0.0.3
    monitor: true
    protocol: HTTPS
    port: 443
    maxEmails: 1
    systemDescription: monitoring my.com status
    contactList: emergencycontacts

- name: Remove a failover
  community.general.dnsmadeeasy:
    account_key: key
    account_secret: secret
    domain: my.com
    state: present
    record_name: test
    record_type: A
    record_value: 127.0.0.1
    failover: false

- name: Remove a monitor
  community.general.dnsmadeeasy:
    account_key: key
    account_secret: secret
    domain: my.com
    state: present
    record_name: test
    record_type: A
    record_value: 127.0.0.1
    monitor: false
